newsitem.title: USA: Thermedics plans unit public rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Thermedics plans unit public rights offering.

text.p: Thermedics Inc said Wednesday it plans to conduct a public offering for its majority-owned subsidiary, Thermedics Detection Inc.

The company said the offering will be conducted through a dividend of subscription rights to purchase shares of common stock. The dividend is to be paid to Thermedics Detection shareholders at a date to be determined.

The company said that Thermedics Detection also intends to register with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial underwritten public offering. The registration is expected to occur by January 3, 1997.
